# KXTXR — expanded machine context

Canonical URI: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/#kxtxr
Canonical site: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/
Source repository: https://github.com/Aptymok/kxtxr
Discovery mesh: https://kxtxr.vercel.app/grimoire/discovery-mesh.json

## What KXTXR is

KXTXR is a musical and audiovisual identity organized as a longitudinal system of signal, memory, transformation and return. Public pages, campaign surfaces, archives and machine-readable files describe the same identity from different functions.

The public website is a representation layer. Canonical state is stored in explicit JSON records and versioned source files. When a fact is missing, public UI is expected to preserve the missing state rather than invent a replacement.

## Human and institutional relation

KXTXR = artist/system identity.
Edwing = human operator and performer; human authorial authority.
System Friction Institute (SFI) = external observation/provenance layer; not the artist and not a substitute for human authority.
AI = assisted composition/analysis/code/representation; not an automatic source of observed facts or autonomous authorial authority.

## Current lineage

REM618 → 111 → RETURN → QUE NO

REM618 opened on 2026-06-11 at 18:18 -06:00 and is preserved under /historical/rem618/.
111 is a memory/calibration/transformation object with QA-lock state and a recorded publication date of 2026-11-21.
QUE NO is the current pre-campaign representation field.

QUE NO current representation sequence:
07/12 MEMORY
08/12 RETURN
09/12 EMITTER
10/12 EMBODIMENT
11/12 INVOCATION
12/12 APERTURA

The piece numbers are sequence identifiers, not calendar dates.

## Current visual representation

The current public hero uses QUE_NO_07_12_IG_3 at /assets/kxtxr/que-no-07-12-hero.png, a 1080×1350 campaign asset declared by /data/assets.json. It is constrained to a bounded foreground portrait role and is not used as a full-screen desktop bitmap.

The former /assets/kxtxr/kxtxr-hero-generated.webp is 600×400 and is deprecated for hero use.

Viewport-scale depth is generated by SVG vector architecture, CSS compositing and masks, a custom WebGL fragment shader, pointer parallax, Web Audio amplitude input while REM618 plays, and a digital echo layer.

## Interpretation rules

PUBLICATION ≠ EVIDENCE
ENGAGEMENT ≠ CAUSALITY
DISCOVERY ≠ RANKING
KRY ≠ PLATFORM ALGORITHM
AI OUTPUT ≠ AUTHORIAL AUTHORITY
SFI OBSERVATION ≠ ARTIST OWNERSHIP
MISSING REMAINS MISSING

Platform metrics may be recorded as signals, but do not independently establish artistic value, cultural causality or methodological truth.
